Third-party corroboration ties the same woman to the same unit: a JustDial listing titled 'Dr. Suma Sandhyala - Plastic And Cosmetic Surgeon In Apollo, Opposite Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan School, Jubilee Hills' (JustDial used as a name/venue signal only - no JustDial phone number was taken, they are call-tracking proxies).

OWN CLINIC: prettyu.com is her own practice. The page https://prettyu.com/about-us carries the page title 'Dr.Suma Sandhyala', and search output from her own site states she is the FOUNDER of Pretty U Cosmetic Clinic, with the NIMS MCh / Best Resident Award / New York observership credentials. owns_clinic therefore set true.

EMAIL: info@prettyu.com was RE-SEARCHED AS AN EXACT PHRASE per the mandatory rule and came back attached to real indexed pages on her clinic's own domain (prettyu.com home, book-appoinment, blog, terms, privacy) plus the clinic's own Instagram and Facebook pages. It is a clinic business mailbox (institutional), not a private personal address.

PHONE DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK: the only published clinic number found (91 33 733 733 series) is a 10-digit Indian mobile-series number, which the brief excludes when an institutional line is required. Apollo publishes no per-doctor number. JustDial numbers were rejected outright as call-tracking proxies.

INSTAGRAM - READ BEFORE USE: https://www.instagram.com/dr.sumasandhyala/ is recorded as her professional account. It surfaced repeatedly and top-ranked on queries that paired her exact distinctive name with 'plastic surgeon Hyderabad' and with 'Pretty U', the handle is her own name with a 'dr.' prefix, and search output attributes it to her with ~7,529 followers / 132 posts. Page-level bio confirmation was impossible in this environment, so the tie is index-level rather than bio-level - a human should glance at the bio before outreach. The clinic-brand accounts (@prettyucosmeticclinic, facebook.com/prettyu.hyderabad, x.com/prettyu_hyd) were deliberately NOT put in the instagram/facebook/twitter fields, because they belong to the clinic entity rather than to her personally; they are listed in other_profiles with that label. No hospital social account was recorded anywhere.
